profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Principal Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry. Strong consulting professional skilled in Domain Name System (DNS), BMC Remedy, Servers, Data Center, and Networking.

positions.title: OpenShift/PaaS Architect
positions.description:
Design and implement highly scalable/highly available OpenShift PaaS enterprise architectures.
Demonstrate understanding of cross-functional/cross-domain requirements and impact.
Maintain knowledge of current and emerging technologies/products/trends related to architectural solutions.
Ensure alignment of solutions with business and IT goals/objectives.
Identify and quantify scope and impact of business changes on systems.
Facilitate/lead/participate in identification of solution options and features.
Communicate solution options to business owners/stakeholders (e.g. architecture reviews).
Incorporate software and system architecture (e.g. infrastructure, network) into conceptual designs.
Ensure alignment with enterprise technology standards (e.g. solution patterns, application frameworks, technology roadmaps, capital plans).
Identify gaps between established standards and proposed solutions.
Develops innovative approaches.

positions.title: OpenShift PaaS Senior Consultant
positions.description:
Specialize in the design and development of automated container platforms, deployment pipelines, and distributed application architectures.
Deliver next-generation distributed applications and delivery workflows on large-scale container management clusters using Docker, Kubernetes, Ansible, Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) Atomic, and OpenShift.

positions.title: Unix System Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for the daily operations of over 300+ Red Hat, Solaris and HPUX servers.
ITIL v3 Certified
OS Deployment and tuning.
OS level application support of JBOSS, RH Cluster, WebMethods, Confluence, SOA, Veritas Cluster, DataStage, Oracle and SAP.
Developed and deployed a migration strategy to move over 200 servers from Solaris to Linux including the financial and streaming media services that they maintained.

positions.title: NOC Shift Lead
positions.description:
Supervised a crew of eight to ensure proper monitoring, resolution and escalation of trouble tickets and site wide issues.
Primary escalation point for global issues including email, ftp, dns, web servers, network backbone and site level, global applications and third party vpn inegration.
Controlled scheduling and outage of night shift employees.

positions.title: NOC
positions.description:
Network monitoring and troubleshooting of the infrastructure backbone.
Service ticket creation and escalation with third party vendors.
Resolution of site and system wide outages.
Training for junior NOC employee's.

positions.title: System Administrator
positions.description:
Worked as a sub-contractor responsible for the migration of the AMCC to Fort Belvoir.
Relocated servers, routers, switches, printers and desktops to their new facility.
Reconfigured and joined the newly located equipment to the Army network and ensured service.

educations.schoolName: University of the District of Columbia
